fullDesc: On June 12, 1967 the Supreme Court ruled unanimously in Loving v. Virginia that state bans on interracial marriage were unconstitutional. At that time 16 states still had such laws.
realFacts: Richard and Mildred Loving were jailed for marrying
They brought the case with help from the ACLU
The ruling struck down all such state laws
Loving Day is celebrated on June 12
